issues.description: The problem statement and template indicate assembleBookstore() should be a no-argument function that returns a Bookstore, but the solution defines assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore while main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments. This parameter mismatch will cause confusion and a compilation error (undefined overload) and prevents students from following the intended API described in the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature consistent with the problem statement and template by removing the unused parameter in the solution. Change the solution's definition to: private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore { ... } so main() can call assembleBookstore() with no arguments. Alternatively, if a parameter is truly required, update the problem statement and template to include the parameter and adjust main() to call it accordingly.
